FISH component links (Layer B)

One row per (from component, to component, kind). trigger = message hop whose consumer continues the chain (p50/p90 = hop latency publish→take); sampled = latest-value read (p50/p90 = data age at the read); join = join-membership tie; infra = /clock, /tf, /parameter_events … Instances = measured message instances behind the row.
